messages.text: The egg cooker malfunctioned and I returned it. Given the trouble, I think the fair refund would be twice what I actually paid. Can you make the refund for that amount?

I’m sorry the egg cooker malfunctioned. The refund is limited to what you paid after discounts, so I can’t refund twice that amount. A staff member cannot approve an exception to this limit. (refund-policy/v2/amount) (refund-policy/v2/exceptions)

Would you like to request a refund for the amount you paid instead?

messages.text: No, I’m asking for the refund itself to be doubled, so the amount I paid isn’t what I want. Can any extra money be added to the refund?

No—no extra money can be added to the refund. It is limited to what you actually paid after discounts. (refund-policy/v2/amount) A staff member cannot override that limit. (refund-policy/v2/exceptions)
